simple.summary: רִקֻּעַ (riqquaʻ) means beaten out, i.e. a (metallic) plate First listed occurrence: Num 17 3.

definitions.full: H7555. riqqua [ רִקּוּעַ ] noun [masculine] expansion ; — plural construct פַחִים רִקֻּעֵי אֹתָם וְעָשׂוּ Num 17:3 expansions of plates , i.e. they shall be beaten into broad plates.
